title: Exact omission of unused modern LFO readouts
evidence_class: Software continuation and routing-ownership contract; modern LFOs are not CS-80 circuitry or hardware measurements.

gate.phase_comparison: Both float historical phase and double shape phase after every sample, including disabled intervals.
gate.default_api: Omitting the new emit flag retains the frozen baseline output on every sample.

frozen_reference: Freeze the baseline ModulationLfo.h with only include/namespace qualification changed and record source/fixture SHA256.
cases: All seven waveforms, long disabled intervals, repeated disabled/enabled edges, finite zero/slow/fast rates, wrap transitions, waveform changes, reset and copy continuation across all six rates.
Selected S&H and smooth-random state transitions and random draws continue while output is unused; the first and every subsequent enabled sample must match the frozen class exactly.
The source-policy Engine emits whenever direct depth is nonzero OR the modern matrix is active. Legacy retains its original three-argument call.
At source policy, a positive direct-depth route must change rendered samples relative to depth zero; omitting direct-depth ownership must fail this check.
At source policy, a matrix route from an LFO at zero direct depth must render bit-identically to the same matrix route with positive but unconnected direct depth; omitting matrix ownership must fail.

A modern constant-to-disabled-FX route can force a reference Engine to emit all LFO readouts without affecting audio. Compare its audio bit-for-bit to an otherwise identical inactive-matrix Engine through unused intervals and subsequent direct-depth activation.
PURE remains byte-inert for modern waveform/routing choices. No thresholds or fades are introduced.
mutation_requirements: Freeze disabled phases: phase and wake comparisons must fail.
Suppress selected S&H random updates while disabled: enabled random outputs must fail.
Suppress selected smooth-random updates while disabled: enabled random outputs must fail.
Remove direct-depth ownership from the Engine emit predicate: direct routing gate must fail.
Remove active-matrix ownership from the Engine emit predicate: matrix equality gate must fail.
verification: Root runs legacy default, legacy tails, v1 and strict-v2 compatibility.
Preserve a separate source_factory_benchmark snapshot and root measures minimum three before/after rounds.
